mark start
warp Market_Adult Market_Entrance adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark llegada
wait 3000               # B loads after A (r03_pareja) or with it (run.ps1): wait for it
mark r01-nave              # the Temple of Time's nave (where the Prelude of Light lands)
place 84.80 104.20 -34.00
wait 300
wait 600               # the other one sees us in this room
mark r02-puerta            # the Door of Time and the three stones
place 106.00 104.90 -34.00
wait 300
flag Market_Child_TimeTempleDoor_Opened 1
wait 600
mark r03-pedestal          # the Master Sword's pedestal
place 133.50 104.90 -34.00
wait 300
wait 600
mark r04-despertar         # where the adult Link wakes
place 120.50 105.70 -26.70
wait 300
wait 600
mark fin
